title: Vehicle pricing and value
summary: Feedback on pricing is split between value-for-money approval and complaints that the car feels expensive, while many excerpts mention high price without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car feels worth the money or enjoyable despite a high price.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the car as expensive, though one sampled excerpt appears mislabeled and examples are limited.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often state that the price is high or mention price alone without enough context to tell whether this is praise, criticism, or a tradeoff.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short, which leaves sentiment unclear in many cases.
One negative example appears textually positive, suggesting possible label noise in the sample.
The examples focus narrowly on price level and provide limited detail on what features or competitors reviewers used as value benchmarks.
